answer_1.quote: Visual captioning serves as a foundation for image/video understanding tools and relies on caption evaluation for identifying promising research directions.

answer_2.quote: We then benchmark our proposed caption evaluation metrics against the rule-based metrics used in the Microsoft COCO 2015 Captioning Competition, which still serve as the standard for caption evaluation, and the recall-idf configuration of BERTScore.

answer_4.quote: Human evaluations of competition entries were collected using Amazon Mechanical Turk (AMT). These evaluations were framed as questions from which 2 primary dimensions of system-level caption quality were derived as a ground truth to rank competitors: M1 (percentage better than or equal to human description) and M2 (percentage passing the Turing Test).
answer_4.guideline: Questions framed to derive dimensions M1 and M2, with M1 assessing if captions are better/equal to human descriptions and M2 assessing if they pass a Turing Test.
